## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the commands you actually ran and their results. Explain any checks you did not run.
Use temporary state, synthetic IDs and fake model subprocesses for reproductions.

## Review

- [ ] This change includes no credentials, cookies, private workspace files, transcripts or raw model events.
- [ ] Dependency locks are preserved; compatibility changes are explained above.
- [ ] Authorization, recovery or protocol changes include a focused regression test.

Local offline tests do not establish live account or service compatibility.
